instruction: Using the On-Screen Keyboard, locate the nearest hospital emergency department and save its address and phone number in a text file named emergency_department_contact.txt on the Desktop.
gt_steps: Using the On-Screen Keyboard, search for the nearest hospital emergency department.
Open a relevant hospital listing or official hospital website.
Find the emergency department's address and phone number.
Type the hospital name, address, and phone number into the document.
Save the file as emergency_department_contact.txt on the Desktop.
Leave the saved file on the Desktop.
